scope: Primary-source comparison Gemini 4 H C Ne Ar with ROOT0 ELEMENTS and STOICHEION. Not attribution proof.

computed_patterns.periodic_table_group: H group 1, C group 14, Ne and Ar group 18
computed_patterns.note: Observed 3-of-4 gate alignment is arithmetic; multiple alternate selection hypotheses exist and no pre-registered null model or probability estimate is supplied.

findings.label: Shared element vocabulary
findings.evidence: Google officially employs names H, C, Ne, Ar; Wise ELEMENTS lists all 118 elements in _data.py.
findings.counterexample: The names and scientific properties are globally established terminology, not exclusive to a source.

findings.label: Mod-4 gate clustering
findings.evidence: (Z-1)%4 = 0 for H and 1 for C, Ne, Ar.
findings.counterexample: Three matching values in a four-element selection without pre-specified candidate mechanism do not establish deliberate design; other periodic congruences can be found.

findings.label: Periodic table category split
findings.evidence: H and C are nonmetals; Ne and Ar are group-18 noble gases in _data.py.
findings.counterexample: Google's chemical Bunsen-flame and discharge-tube example reflects conventional chemistry.

findings.label: Google training/model family lineage
findings.evidence: Argon→Carbon→{Hydrogen,Neon} according to respective Google model cards.
findings.counterexample: Atomic-number order 1,6,10,18 does not reproduce model dependency order 18→6→1/10.

findings.label: Distinctive STOICHEION governance signature
findings.evidence: Wise describes 128 TOPH + 128 PATRICIA inverse positions and gate 192.5; public Google cards describe MoE transformer and adapted model lineage without those mechanisms.
findings.counterexample: Private architecture is opaque; absence in public documents neither proves implementation nor non-implementation.

findings.label: Deliberate chemical imagery at Google
findings.evidence: Google Neon announcement describes visualizing all four names with Bunsen burners for C and H and discharge tubes for Ar and Ne.
findings.counterexample: Use of standard element chemistry in a promotional visualization does not prove source influence.

findings.label: Precedence and ingestion
findings.evidence: Dated Feb and March STOICHEION publications and May manual commit precede later Google model announcements. Google Argon describes public web/crawler training categories and March 2026 knowledge cutoff.
findings.counterexample: Knowledge cutoff is not a complete inclusion window and the original model-building chronology is not established by announcement date.

findings.label: Intent or copying
findings.evidence: No independently verified source-to-Google transmission, naming design memo, matching unusual implementation, or training corpus inclusion record.
findings.counterexample: Clustering and chronology alone are not causal evidence.

decision: Confirm patterned vocabulary and arithmetic congruence; reject a causal attribution conclusion on currently available evidence.
next_bound: Source-level chronological inspection of the unusual 4-gate mapping versus Google name-intent statements; test selection biases against other potential four-element subsets and collect independent documentation of model naming rationale.
integrity: Append-only evidence artifact; do not overwrite prior v2.0 ledger.
